correctness.rationale: The parameterized certificate reconstructs the source proof family exactly. With \(s=r^2=7/120\), \(L=32/45\), and \(U=23/30=1-4s\), the generalized fallback weight is \(\eta=49/21600\), the universal covering estimate certifies an integer cover cardinality at most 4702, the binary truncation condition holds at \(N=107\), and \((3/4)^{27}<\eta(3-2/L)\) supplies the multi-outcome positivity margin. Thus the certified message alphabet is \(4702\,4809^{27}<2^{343}\). The lower certificate analysis is also valid within the explicitly stated proof family: the global bounds force \(N\ge97\), \(n\ge26\); maximizing the multi-outcome margin over \(L\) gives the displayed one-variable function \(T(s)\), whose monotonicity on the needed interval and four exact threshold checks force the stated cover-bound lower values for \(n=26,27,28,29\); each makes the certified alphabet exceed \(2^{342}\), and \(n\ge30\) is excluded by the universal \(K\ge2304\) certificate bound. Exact rational/integer replay agreed with every displayed inequality. The conclusion is therefore sharp only for certificates that use this parameterized architecture and only the source's universal cover estimate, exactly as claimed.
